Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
Mr. Rishab Ranghar, learned counsel 
for the applicant.
2. Ms. Sweta Badola Dobhal, learned Brief 
Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Sagar Kothari, learned counsel for 
respondent no.2.
4. After interaction with both the parties 
what this Court has observed that there is no 
issue at all in between both of them and there 
is only issue of ego.
5. This Court is of the view that both the 
parties may think over it and make all 
possible efforts to live together and then 
apprise to this Court.
6. Put up on 08.10.2026.
7. In the meantime, both the parties are 
directed not to pursue any pending 
proceeding and move appropriate 
application for seeking adjournment. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
